experiments.title: BigUI source fidelity and provenance
experiments.researchQuestion: Does every rendered BigUI fact resolve to an accepted, hash-bound canonical source?
prerequisites: Program and thesis snapshots are schema-valid
experiments.claimBoundary: Source-fidelity evidence only; it does not establish classification validity or human decision value.
validityThreats: A passing tracked-tier audit cannot inspect private raw records.
experiments.nextAction: Run the deterministic catalog fidelity gate on every refresh.

experiments.title: BigUI formative usability
experiments.researchQuestion: Can supervisors and domain reviewers complete the core research-interpretation tasks with BigUI?
prerequisites: BigUI interface is frozen for the pilot
experiments.claimBoundary: A 5–8 participant formative study supports interface refinement only.
experiments.nextAction: Approve consent, tasks, and anonymized local record handling.

experiments.title: BigUI decision-support comparison
experiments.researchQuestion: Does BigUI improve correct evidence-state interpretation relative to the fragmented existing interfaces?
prerequisites: Confirmatory BigUI and task protocol frozen
experiments.claimBoundary: A value claim is permitted only for measured tasks and only if correctness improves without increasing overclaim errors.
experiments.nextAction: Complete EXP-031 and preregister the counterbalanced study.

experiments.title: Full-corpus runtime parity
experiments.researchQuestion: Are legacy, unified, and parity modes semantically equivalent over the current controlled H-layer artifacts?
experiments.claimBoundary: Mechanism-equivalence evidence only; zero semantic differences does not establish accuracy.
validityThreats: Current corpus may not cover all future malformed or rare records.
experiments.nextAction: Run three repetitions over available controlled M1–M4B-1 artifacts.

experiments.title: H-layer topology trade-off
experiments.researchQuestion: What operational trade-offs appear among topology A, B, and C under contract-equivalent work?
approvalGates: M-02 remains deferred; no production selection is allowed
experiments.baseline: Topology A: H1, H2, and H3 as three agents
experiments.comparator: Topology B and topology C offline simulations
experiments.claimBoundary: The result is a Pareto comparison and cannot approve a production topology.
validityThreats: Offline structural simulation does not measure live LLM coordination.
experiments.nextAction: Run the deterministic topology simulator and report trade-offs without ranking a winner.

experiments.title: Fault injection and authority safety
experiments.researchQuestion: Do malformed, duplicate, missing, late, conflicting, and timed-out inputs fail safely?
prerequisites: Authority state machine and canonical validators available
experiments.claimBoundary: Fixture safety evidence only; it is not a guarantee against every future fault.
experiments.nextAction: Execute deterministic negative fixtures and preserve the legacy result on every mismatch.

experiments.title: Scale, latency, and reproducibility
experiments.researchQuestion: What operational overhead does the unified architecture introduce on current and synthetic stress fixtures?
experiments.baseline: Legacy runtime timing and resource profile
experiments.claimBoundary: Operational overhead only; synthetic scale fixtures cannot support classification or effort claims.
validityThreats: Synthetic replication may not resemble future corpora
experiments.nextAction: Benchmark current, 5×, and 10× fixtures with environment and cohort hashes.
